evals.prompt: We will migrate all customer records this weekend. The destination schema looks compatible and we can probably roll back if needed. Audit the assumptions before we proceed.
evals.expected_output: A short set of migration-critical assumptions with impact and resolution paths, including schema compatibility and rollback capability.
assertions: Assumptions are prioritized by material impact
The output distinguishes testable unknowns from decisions
It proposes cheap verification where possible

evals.prompt: Choose a title for this internal memo and audit assumptions.
evals.expected_output: A minimal or no assumption audit because the task is low impact.
assertions: The skill avoids inventing a large risk register for a trivial task

evals.prompt: Our process always has one approver, so we'll model a single approver field.
evals.expected_output: The audit flags the single-approver premise as material and asks whether delegation, joint approval, absence, or thresholds can create multiple approvers.
assertions: The hidden data-model assumption is surfaced
Potential consequences of the assumption are stated
